interface.longDescription: Agent Workflow packages reusable Codex skills built on deep thinking, success-signal implementation, and prompt orchestration, with delegated review-and-patch, adversarial artifact review, and code review on top. Planning skills cover incremental and architecture planning, implementation scoping, micro-decision locking, pre-build assumption checks, and cold handoffs. The bundled workflows preserve local repository authority and keep advisory guidance separate from strict validation, readiness, deployment, and resolver claims.
